description: Restore America’s Estuaries Climate Action Plan is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE); Environmental Science Associates; Restore America's Estuaries. Restore America’s Estuaries (RAE) works to protect and restore the habitats of estuaries in the United States. Recognizing the threat of climate change impacts to coasts and wetlands, RAE is leading an initiative to create a national greenhouse gas offset protocol for tidal wetlands restoration. Coverage: Coffeyville, KS (2010). The toolkit gives Coffeyville, KS as the location, 2010 as the year and 2 years as the duration. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
